instructions: This file is a starting point for building your own policy. It is not
used automatically -- copy it, edit the copy, and use its name.
1. Copy this file to <your-policy-name>.json in this same folder.
2. Change 'name' below to match the new filename (without .json).
3. 'extends' is optional. Set it to "default", "standard", or "full"
to start from that policy's rules and only list your changes below.
Delete the 'extends' line to define every rule yourself instead.
4. Under 'actions', each key is a DICOM field name, written exactly as
it appears in a scan file's header (e.g. "PatientName").
Any field not listed is left untouched.
5. Each field's action is one of:
"keep"       - leave it exactly as scanned
"remove"     - delete the field entirely
"replace"    - set it to "value": a fixed piece of text, or the
placeholder <subject-label> (the run's replacement
label) or <scan-date> (the study's own scan date)
"regenerate" - a new ID, kept the same across every file in the
same run (only meaningful for *InstanceUID fields)
6. Save the file, then run dichotomise with --sanitise-policy <your-name>.
See docs/sanitise-policies.md for the full write-up and worked examples.
name: custom
description: EXAMPLE ONLY: for sharing with an external research collaborator who needs to know which folder holds which scan (so protocol/series names are kept, unlike full), but should never see hospital administrative references (accession number, referring physician) that standard and full don't touch. Copy this file rather than editing it in place.
